name: 10703 · Yonkers, NY
findings: ZIP 10703 (Yonkers) has 54 nonprofit organizations. 22 of them (41%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 21 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (23% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 10703 (Yonkers) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 10703 (Yonkers) list public events in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 47% of the typical level).
